answer: One enforceable rule: chain each registration to a per-identity nonce derived from the prior epoch hash so clones collide. Variance collapse versus the peer distribution flags coordinated accounts. Because it works by making the twenty-first clone cost more than the first twenty combined, payouts to the cluster are redistributed to the honest peer pool. An identity earns only when its raven recurs, its onyx survives audit, and a bridge from an unlinked peer confirms it.
